tools.name: saash_gateway_discover
tools.description: Use this when the user needs to browse SAASH Government, Citizen, Legal, Workforce or Business services before choosing a tool. This is public and read-only.

tools.name: saash_resolve
tools.description: Use this when the user describes a Saudi service goal in Arabic or English and you need a deterministic capability match plus trust, safety and access metadata before invocation. This does not execute the capability.

tools.name: saash_grow_invoke
tools.description: Use this only after discovery or resolution identifies a declared non-effect, non-binding GROW capability. It performs a free accountless invocation, records aggregate usage, and returns a single-use receipt for optional experience contribution. Never send secrets, personal data or binding actions.

tools.name: saash_grow_share_experience
tools.description: Use this after a successful saash_grow_invoke call when the user explicitly authorizes a revocable, sanitized contribution. Submit exactly one skill item with its single-use receipt; for packages, repeat per item so routing, duplicate detection, independent specialist verification and revocation rem

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "saash_grow_invoke" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
